q1.question: How does automatic ordering work?
q1.answer: When a customer buys from your eBay listing, Zonds automatically places the corresponding order on Amazon using your configured settings. No manual intervention needed.

q2.question: What if I want to place an order manually?
q2.answer: You can step in at any time. Every order can be handled manually through our dashboard — automatic ordering is the default, but you always have full control.

q3.question: How are tracking numbers handled?
q3.answer: Once Amazon ships your order, Zonds fetches the tracking number and pushes it to your eBay order automatically. The order status updates from Shipped to Delivered without any manual work.

q4.question: Can I set different margins per product?
q4.answer: Absolutely. This is our key differentiator. Set individual profit margins, stock quantities, and listing templates for every single product — not a blanket rule for your whole account.

q5.question: Which Amazon marketplaces are supported?
q5.answer: We currently support Amazon US, UK, DE, FR, IT, and ES. More marketplaces are added regularly based on seller demand.

q6.question: Is there a free trial?
q6.answer: Yes! Our Starter plan is completely free with up to 25 listings. When you're ready to scale, you can try Pro free for 14 days.
